title: Law to require a city AI emergency response plan
summary: This bill would require the Office of Technology and Innovation's Cyber Command, working with NYC Emergency Management, to create or update a plan for responding to emergencies caused by artificial intelligence models within 120 days of the law taking effect. The plan must be reviewed and updated annually and submitted to the Mayor and Council Speaker. The agencies would also have to file yearly progress reports on AI-related emergencies and the plan's implementation.
